name: file_dup3

ownership.argument: Duplicate a retained source file into a zeroed, aligned, caller-owned 32-byte struct file. On success close the owned copy with file_close, not fs_putfilep.

provenance.source: Exact Q66 .155 IDB recovery for fd-independent QJS event-loop notification, 2026-10-30; native async wake EBADF captured at C3F5758.

notes: Private exact-target ABI record; not public callable approval or physical validation. Entry bytes: 2d e9 f8 43 0d 46 91 46 06 46 00 af. NuttX file slots are 32 bytes (C332B70). File references increment under interrupt critical section (C332B78-C332B7E).
